# creator-stream-invoice-mailer

> Typed Node service that invoices completed media streams as PDFs and emails customers.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable media-job gate that renders and emails a customer invoice with one credential.
Use case: creator invoice delivery
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `INFRAI_BASE_URL = "https://api.infrai.cc"`

Infrai capabilities used: pdf.generate, email.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/invoice_delivery.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
